Modifier requiring msg.sender == owner before executing any guarded function body.
onlyOwner function transferring ownership after rejecting address(0).
onlyOwner function setting owner to address(0), permanently disabling privileged functions.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written into the owner state variable by the Ownable constructor, granting privileged role to the caller.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against owner, so the authorization decision depends on caller-controlled input.
transferOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner and therefore consumes the caller identity.
renounceOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner and therefore consumes the caller identity.
The onlyOwner modifier reverts unless msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership executes.
The onlyOwner modifier reverts unless msg.sender == owner before renounceOwnership executes.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] and emits msg.sender as the Transfer source.
transferFrom reads and decrements allowed[_from][msg.sender].
approve keys the allowance map with msg.sender.
increaseApproval keys the allowance map with msg.sender.
decreaseApproval keys the allowance map with msg.sender.
The SNL constructor credits the whole initial supply to msg.sender.
Constructor writes msg.sender into owner.
transferOwnership overwrites owner with newOwner.
renounceOwnership sets owner to address(0).
totalSupply() returns totalSupply_.
transfer mutates balances[msg.sender] and balances[_to].
balanceOf reads balances[_owner].
transferFrom mutates balances[_from] and balances[_to].
transferFrom decrements allowed[_from][msg.sender].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
allowance reads allowed[_owner][_spender].
increaseApproval adds to allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
decreaseApproval rewrites allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
SNL constructor sets balances[msg.sender] = INITIAL_SUPPLY.
SNL constructor sets totalSupply_ = INITIAL_SUPPLY.
SNL constructor reads the INITIAL_SUPPLY constant for minting.
_transfer mutates balances[_from] and balances[_to].
transfer calls SafeMath.sub on the sender balance.
transfer calls SafeMath.add on the recipient balance.
transferFrom calls SafeMath.sub on balances and allowance.
transferFrom calls SafeMath.add on the recipient balance.
increaseApproval calls SafeMath.add on the allowance.
decreaseApproval calls SafeMath.sub on the allowance.
_transfer calls SafeMath.sub on balances[_from].
_transfer calls SafeMath.add on balances[_to].
When _value == 0 the owner.transfer(address(this).balance) branch performs an external ether call.
When _value != 0 the owner.transfer(_value) branch performs an external ether call.
The external call to owner can re-enter safeWithdrawal before the withdrawal completes.
The external call to owner can re-enter safeWithdrawal before the withdrawal completes.
_transfer evaluates the raw balances[_to] + _value expression, which can overflow before the require check.
newOwner is the value written to owner by transferOwnership.

_spender indexes the allowance map in allowance.
